'''0.18e''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that improved optimization and fixed some issues with the updater.

==Changelog==
* RAM usage decreased by ~100MB
* In windowed mode one can't change window size

===Bug fixes===
* Mouse movement error
* Crash when one equips player with a gun without ammo
* Crash in updater during decompression
* Crash in updater during version checking
* Folders content resync: versions [[0.18d]] and [[0.18c]]
